hero.title: ABOUT
hero.subtitle: SOFTWARE Developer
hero.description: I'm a software developer focused on building practical, reliable, and user-friendly digital experiences. I enjoy turning complex requirements into clean and maintainable interfaces.

paragraphs: I'm a software developer who enjoys working on applications that solve real-world problems.
My experience includes building web applications, developing reusable UI components, integrating APIs, and working with existing enterprise systems.
I particularly enjoy the process of understanding a problem, breaking it down into smaller pieces, and turning it into an intuitive experience for the people who will actually use it.

journey.title: STUDIED Information Technology
journey.description: BS Information Technology with Specialization in Mobile and Internet Technologies, consistent Dean's Lister for the whole academic year 2022 to 2026.

journey.title: STARTED AS INTERN
journey.description: Joined Exist Software Labs as a Front-End Developer Intern, gaining hands-on experience in front-end development, contributing to real-world software projects, and collaborating with experienced developers in a professional environment.

journey.title: WORKED ON MACEA PROJECT
journey.description: Contributed to MACEA, a multi-stage permit application system built with Angular, TypeScript, and PrimeNG. Built data tables with frozen columns and role-based column visibility, integrated REST APIs for permit retrieval, cancellation, and document downloads, and implemented responsive layouts for both desktop and mobile.

journey.title: BECAME SOFTWARE DEVELOPER TRAINEE
journey.description: Transitioned into a Software Developer Trainee role at Exist Software Labs, taking on more ownership across projects, deeper debugging work, and closer collaboration with the development team.

journey.title: WORKED ON EMR SYSTEMS
journey.description: Built and maintained modules for CGH Digitalization, an AngularJS-based EMR system, covering patient care plans, treatment records, and medication management. Implemented pagination, role-based permissions, concurrency/stale-detection polling, and cross-browser fixes across multiple modules.

journey.title: EXPANDING SKILLS
journey.description: Expanding my skills in cloud technologies, QA, manual and automation, and AI while exploring new areas beyond frontend development.

capabilities.title: FRONTEND

capabilities.title: BACKEND
capabilities.description: Building REST APIs and database-driven backends with Node.js, Express, FastAPI, and Supabase for full-stack side projects.

capabilities.title: USER EXPERIENCE
capabilities.description: Creating interfaces that are clear, consistent, responsive, and easy to use.

capabilities.title: PROBLEM SOLVING
capabilities.description: Debugging complex application behavior and finding practical solutions to technical problems.

capabilities.title: QUALITY ASSURANCE
capabilities.description: Doing manual and automation testing to catch issues early and keep features reliable before they ship.
